title: Comprehensive analysis of AHL genes in Malus domestica reveals the critical role of MdAHL6 in flowering induction.
authors: Yan, Rui; Yang, Kaiyu; Zhang, Tianle; Sharif, Rahat; Yang, Siyu; Li, Siyu; Wang, Ning; Liu, Jiale; Zhao, Shengnan; Wang, Wenxiu; Zhang, Xuemei; Dong, Qinglong; Luan, Haoan; Guo, Suping; Wang, Yuan; Qi, Guohui; Jia, Peng
one_liner_zh: 该文对苹果AHL基因家族进行系统分析，并通过Y1H、EMSA、分子对接等实验揭示MdAHL6转录因子直接结合DNA的AT富集区抑制MdFT表达，涉及TF-DNA互作但以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟方法仅分子对接辅助，深度有限。
abstract: AT-hook motif nuclear localized (AHL) genes are crucial in various biological processes, yet the AHL gene family in apples has remained largely unexplored. In this study, we isolated 36 MdAHL genes from the apple genome and grouped them into two distinct clades. We characterized the gene structure, conserved motifs, protein biochemical properties, and promoter regions of the MdAHL genes. Transcriptional analysis revealed that MdAHL genes are preferentially and predominantly expressed in flowers and leaves. Notably, during the floral induction phase, the MdAHL6 gene exhibited remarkably high transcriptional activity. Overexpression of MdAHL6 resulted in shortened hypocotyls and delayed flowering by regulating hypocotyl- and floral-related genes. Y1H, EMSA, GUS activity, and molecular docking assays revealed that MdAHL6 directly binds to AT-rich regions, inhibiting the expression of FLOWERING LOCUS T (MdFT). Furthermore, Y2H, pull-down, and BiFC assays demonstrated a physical interaction between MdAHL6 and the class II knotted-like transcription factor MdKNOX19, which significantly enhances the inhibitory effect of MdAHL6 on MdFT expression. This comprehensive initial analysis unveils the critical role of the MdKNOX19-MdAHL6-MdFT module in flowering induction and lays a theoretical foundation for future functional exploration.
abstract_zh: AT-hook基序核定位（AHL）基因在多种生物过程中至关重要，然而苹果中的AHL基因家族尚未被充分研究。在本研究中，我们从苹果基因组中分离出36个MdAHL基因，并将其分为两个不同的分支。我们表征了MdAHL基因的基因结构、保守基序、蛋白质生化特性及启动子区域。转录分析显示，MdAHL基因优先且主要在花和叶中表达。值得注意的是，在花诱导阶段，MdAHL6基因表现出极高的转录活性。MdAHL6的过表达通过调控下胚轴和花相关基因，导致下胚轴缩短并延迟开花。Y1H、EMSA、GUS活性及分子对接实验揭示，MdAHL6直接结合AT富集区域，抑制FLOWERING LOCUS T（MdFT）的表达。此外，Y2H、pull-down和BiFC实验证明，MdAHL6与II类knotted样转录因子MdKNOX19之间存在物理相互作用，这显著增强了MdAHL6对MdFT表达的抑制作用。这项全面的初步分析揭示了MdKNOX19-MdAHL6-MdFT模块在花诱导中的关键作用，并为未来的功能探索奠定了理论基础。
